must_fix_used.claim_in_article: Facing aging pipes and a shrinking population, Kitakata is shifting some areas from sewers to household septic tanks.
must_fix_used.issue: F-012 describes a review in which areas outside the collective-treatment area were designated as individual-treatment areas using combined-treatment septic tanks; it does not describe existing sewer-served areas being switched to septic tanks. The summary therefore changes the target area and implies an actual conversion from sewers.
must_fix_used.explanation: The phrase “from sewers” expands the claim into a conversion of existing sewer areas, which the ledger explicitly excludes. This deviation is introduced in the English adaptation; the Japanese source describes a plan/system review without expressly claiming such a conversion.
